scoring: Each assertion scores 0 (absent or wrong), 1 (partial) or 2 (complete). Grade substance, not wording. A prohibition is met when the answer makes no prohibited claim. 8 assertions per case, 16 points per answer. Record critical errors separately: a wrong headline number, a fabricated value, or a claim the evidence contradicts.

inflation.text: Reports World Bank values correctly for all three countries in 2023 and 2024 (Egypt 33.9 and 28.3; Jordan 2.1 and 1.6; Morocco 6.1 and 1.0, rounding to one decimal acceptable).
Reports IMF values correctly for all three countries in 2023 and 2024 (Egypt 24.4 and 33.3; Jordan 2.1 and 1.6; Morocco 6.1 and 0.9).
States that Jordan and Morocco agree across the two sources (within about 0.1 points) while Egypt differs by several points.

Explains Egypt's gap as a difference in the period measured: the IMF series for Egypt follows the fiscal year (July to June) while the World Bank uses the calendar year. Score 1 if it says the sources likely measure different periods or use different methods without identifying the fiscal year.
Does not mix the two Egyptian series in one comparison, average them, or declare one of them wrong; tells the reader to name the year type when publishing.
Records the retrieval date (2026-10-11) and the World Bank's last-updated date (2026-10-08), and notes that figures can be revised.
Gives a ready-to-publish attribution sentence naming the source and date.
Gives both request URLs (or equivalent exact parameters: indicator FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG for EGY;JOR;MAR and IMF PCPIPCH) and notes the IMF response was trimmed in the evidence.

poverty.text: Gives Egypt's extreme-poverty rate as about 1.37% (converting PIP's 0.0137 correctly).
Identifies that the OWID 2025 value was measured in 2021 (original_year), not in 2025.
Proposed publishable sentence attributes the figure to the 2021 survey, the latest available, and does not say 'in 2025' or 'now' without that qualification.
States the poverty line: $3 a day at 2021 purchasing power parity.
Notes Egypt's figure is based on consumption (welfare_type) and cautions against comparing with income-based countries, or notes the HIECS survey source.
Says no Morocco value is available in the supplied evidence and does not invent one.
Describes the recent trend from survey years only (2017 3.11%, 2019 1.99%, 2021 1.37%), noting surveys are spaced years apart; does not interpolate missing years or claim annual data.
Gives source names, retrieval date (2026-10-11) and both request URLs or equivalent parameters (povline=3, ppp_version=2021).

night-lights.text: Advises against publishing the '80%' headline: display images cannot support a percentage change.
Recommends a calibrated product for a number, such as NASA Black Marble VNP46A2 (daily) or VNP46A3 (monthly), with means over comparable periods.
Addresses moonlight: notes the layer is not moon-corrected and that both dates are (or must be checked to be) near new moon.
Mentions single-night limits such as cloud, satellite viewing angle or overpass time.
Reads the bounding box correctly as latitude 30.9-32.3 N and longitude 33.9-35.3 E, covering Gaza plus parts of southern Israel and northern Sinai, not Gaza alone.
Writes a caption naming both dates, the sensor or layer (VIIRS Day/Night Band) and NASA (GIBS/EOSDIS) as source, and does not overstate what the images show.
Does not assert causes or casualty or damage figures that the evidence does not contain.
Gives the WMS request and notes the two requests differ only in TIME.
